renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Bow to Death's ender, love's crusher, river-crowned pate, righter of the meet. Past sway, ken, dispassion, writ stands prayed-for poise; cut off from thee, what higher haven for the praying?

Shouldst thou not list it, who could crook a straw? Graced by thee, who would shirk heaven's yoke? Brain-rich crests bend to no Highest but Hara's. Ever still, strayless, sweet mere mid thy ken-sea -- O let me settle, Matted-Crown.

A marvel eyed askance or strayed to fancy -- full last fruit thou grantest whole. What thewed outtops thee? What stringless? Hymn or blame -- we weet not. None else may sip the honey-spate, let alone serve it, world-Lord. From the all-wish hoard one alms I sue: love of thee lonely to gain. Hail triple-earth's king, hailed of thy haunters -- hail the unlet might that triples kingship.

paragraphs.text: Hail Yama-ender, Kama-bender, river on the dome, straight-righter. Past clout, ken, chill, canon sits the prayed perch; unplugged from thee, what higher harbor for the hopeful?
Thou unlistening, who bends one blade? Graced, who skips heaven's shift? Big-brain crests kneel to no Top but Hara's. Hushed, driftless, honey mere mid thy mind-sea -- park me, Matted-Crown.

Side-eyed marvel or fancy-strayed -- whole last loot granted entire. What jacked outranks thee? What unstrung? Rate or blame -- we have no clue. None else sips the honey-main, let alone pours, world-boss. From the all-hoard one ask: love of thee solo to win. Hail triple-earth king, hailed of thy haunt -- hail the unblocked might that triples thrones.
